newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN DENIED NAME CHANGE TO VAN DAMME-KRISHNA.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN DENIED NAME CHANGE TO VAN DAMME-KRISHNA.

text.p: The Hungarian authorities have denied a man's request to change his name to Jean-Claude van Damme Louis Krishna.
"He choose 'Krishna' because of his religious beliefs, van Damme probably to confer on him more strength," interior ministry official Maria Ugroczky told Reuters.
"We could not approve his request as every Hungarian name needs to be clearly divided into first and last name," she aaded.
Last year some 3,500 Hungarians applied for name changes and less than one hundred were refused.
